summary: Fortuna Mining Corp., a Canadian gold and silver producer listed in the US via Form 6-K, furnished its Q3 2026 interim financial statements, MD&A, CEO/CFO certifications, and a November 4, 2026 news release. Results show quarterly sales of $293.4 million, operating income of $102.3 million, and net income of $52.3 million ($0.16 per share basic), with nine-month net income of $256.0 million. The filing is a routine quarterly reporting package for a foreign private issuer, not a special situation; no transaction, price, premium, or board recommendation is stated.
